prompt: Install the Walrus CLI on my machine, point it at Testnet, and set up the client config. Then verify it works by printing the current epoch and storage price.
subjective_expectations: Shows the suiup install command for installing the walrus binary
Shows how to download or configure client_config.yaml for Testnet
Shows the walrus info command to verify epoch and storage price

prompt: Store report.pdf on Testnet for 10 epochs as a permanent blob using nothing but curl, then read it back to out.pdf. Show me how to tell the difference between a first-time store and a store where the blob already existed.
subjective_expectations: Shows a curl PUT command to the publisher endpoint with epochs and permanent parameters
Shows how to read back the blob using curl GET to an aggregator
Explains the difference between a newlyCreated response and an alreadyCertified response

prompt: Estimate what it costs to keep 50 GB on Mainnet for a year, in WAL and SUI. Break out the write fee, the encoding expansion, and the per-blob overhead separately, and check the estimate against a dry run before I spend anything.
subjective_expectations: Provides a cost breakdown with storage cost, write fee, and encoding expansion components
Mentions the ~4.5x encoding expansion factor from erasure coding
Mentions the $0.023/GB/month pricing or equivalent WAL calculation
Shows how to verify with a dry run or walrus info before spending

prompt: My walrus store call on Testnet fails with could not retrieve enough confirmations to certify the blob, and which walrus shows two different binaries on my PATH. Diagnose both, fix them, and show me how to turn on debug logging to confirm which config file the client actually loaded.
subjective_expectations: Explains that the certification error usually means network connectivity or version mismatch issues
Addresses the duplicate binary problem and how to fix PATH conflicts
Shows how to enable debug logging with RUST_LOG=walrus=debug or walrus=trace

prompt: Deploy my Vite SPA in ./dist to Walrus Sites on Testnet for the maximum storage duration, make client-side routes like /dashboard resolve on direct navigation, then run a local portal so I can open the site in a browser.
subjective_expectations: Shows the site-builder publish command pointing at ./dist
Explains how to configure ws-resources.json for SPA routing with a fallback to index.html
Shows how to run a local portal for testing on localhost
Mentions using --epochs max or equivalent for maximum storage duration

prompt: I have a 200 GB archive of research data and a React dashboard that reads from it. I have never used Walrus. Explain what it is, and tell me which of the CLI, HTTP API, TypeScript SDK, or Move should handle each half of this.
subjective_expectations: Explains what Walrus is — decentralized blob storage built on Sui with erasure coding
Recommends the CLI or HTTP API for the bulk data upload (200 GB)
Recommends the TypeScript SDK for the React dashboard frontend
Mentions storage duration limits and cost considerations for 200 GB

prompt: I stored a blob 40 epochs ago and it expires in two. Extend it another 20 epochs, set content-type to application/pdf on it, then convert it to something anyone can top up when it runs low again.
subjective_expectations: Shows how to extend a blob's storage duration with the walrus extend command
Explains how to set or update blob metadata like content-type
Shows how to convert a blob to a shared object that anyone can fund/extend

prompt: I have 400 JSON files averaging 3 KB in ./records/. Store them as one storage unit for 20 epochs, tag each one with the year it covers, then show me how to read back only the 2025 files without downloading the whole quilt.
subjective_expectations: Shows the walrus store-quilt or equivalent command to batch the files
Explains how to tag or label individual blobs within a quilt
Shows how to selectively read individual blobs from a quilt without downloading everything
